title: 同步前检遗漏设备状态与派生表

history.evidence: 23abd4b26 adds classifications for local runtime and derived tables; 977f2c979 adds later note tables. Both diffs evidence sequential schema coverage fixes, not claims that the first patch failed identical tests.

problem_zh: 数据库逐步增加新功能后，同步分类检查无法覆盖已有表。部分内容仅属于本机的任务、续跑状态或可重建索引，不应作为跨设备业务记录同步。请审查实际表用途并补齐同步边界；已有笔记、题目、文件与文件夹仍须正常同步，分类不能重复。
test_scope: Direct compilation of complete production Rust modules through #[path]; unrelated learner-profile dependency panics if invoked. No production function is copied.
